page_title: Free AI Photo Editor & Image Generator

summary.name: Pixlr
summary.one_liner: Pixlr is a browser-based online photo editor with AI tools for image generation, background removal, object removal, upscaling, face swap, and AI video and audio creation.
use_cases: remove photo backgrounds in one click
make photo collages for social media
summary.what_it_does: Pixlr offers an online photo editor that runs in the browser, with adjustments such as brightness and contrast, text and overlays, filters, portrait retouching, and collage layouts. Its AI tools include text-to-image generation, generative fill and expand, background and object removal, AI upscaling up to 25 megapixels, denoise, face swap, sticker creation, and layer decomposition. The page also lists AI video generation from text or images and text-to-speech, transcription, and music generation, using models such as Flux, Kling AI, Recraft, and Google Veo. Pixlr is also listed as available on iOS and Android.
notable: Multiple third-party AI models (Flux, Kling, Veo, Recraft, and others) accessible from one editor
Runs in the browser with no download or installation needed
Free for education according to the page
caveats: Ad-free editing, thousands of AI credits, and access to all models require paid Plus or Premium plans starting at $1.99/month
Free tier is supported by ads and has limited AI credits and models implied by the upgrade pitch
